title: DSNUTILB running RUNSTATS: PARM 'subsystem,utility-id', a free-form control statement continued without a hyphen
shapes: BDLD jcl/BDLDUT5.jcl RUN030: EXEC PGM=DSNUTILB,PARM='DB2P,BDLDRUNS', SYSPRINT and UTPRINT SYSOUT=*, SYSIN holds RUNSTATS TABLESPACE BDLDDB.BDLDTS on one line and UPDATE SPACE on the next
asserts: The step is a jcl_steps fact with program DSNUTILB and parm 'DB2P,BDLDRUNS'; DB2P is the Db2 subsystem and BDLDRUNS the utility id, neither a dataset nor a program. DSNUTILB is system supplied: its EXEC PGM call_sites fact resolves to nothing in the estate and is no gap. The SYSIN stream holds one jcl_utility_cards fact with utility DSNUTILB, dd SYSIN, verb RUNSTATS and operands 'TABLESPACE BDLDDB.BDLDTS UPDATE SPACE': the statement runs over two lines with no continuation hyphen, so it is one fact, not two (the second line is not a verb). BDLDDB.BDLDTS is a database.table-space name, not a dataset. SYSPRINT and UTPRINT are jcl_dds facts with sysout *.
